About Slug-A-Bug

A local company that treats the nest, not just the bug

Slug-A-Bug has served Northern Virginia since 2003. Our integrated pest management approach minimizes pesticide use and maximizes safety for your family or business — while still getting rid of pests for good.

If left unchecked, even common pests like termites can cause serious damage to your property. Our termite and pest control services are the best safety measure to guard against that damage.

Questions about a pest problem? Call us directly — we’re happy to talk it through before you book anything.
